work_intro: Select productions I have led from concept to launch.

items.title: Harry Potter: Visions of Magic
items.description:
Three themed immersive attractions produced for Warner Bros and NEON, bringing the wizarding world to life through experiential design and transmedia production.

Oversaw installation delivery across 3 large-scale instances totalling $4M, managing the creative media production, vendor contract admin and client/partner relationships for 2 traveling modular units deployed across Europe and the Americas, as well as a permanent version at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore.

media.caption: DK designed an immersive touring journey that brings the wizarding world to life through artful, interactive environments.
Guests move through mysterious locations activated by responsive video, theatrical lighting, props, architecture, and sound.
A bespoke interactive wand gives visitors agency, triggering hidden effects and revealing layers of the story.
The environments remix iconic IP into a contemporary multi-sensory experience for global audiences.
Embedded sensors reveal responsive projections, soundscapes, and other hidden traces of magic throughout the rooms.
The experience culminates in an immersive finale with wand-responsive projections and interactive floors.
The global attraction launched across Cologne, Brussels, Singapore, and other touring destinations.
Large-scale scenic environments combine physical build, media, and theatrical cues into a continuous visitor journey.
DK also shaped the brand story, including creative direction, visual identity, and campaign storytelling.

items.title: Manhunt
items.description: Title sequence post-production for the Apple TV+ limited series.

media.caption: DK created a title sequence that drops viewers into the 12-day chase for Lincoln's killer.
The sequence uses restored, colorized, and projection-mapped Civil War imagery with live action and animation.
A corrosive visual treatment evokes damaged 1800s photographic processes and rising national tension.
Kinetic editorial pacing, photogrammetry, and original music build the pressure of a historical thriller.
Degraded imagery centers Booth's rage and the terror of a nation under threat.

items.title: Before
items.description: Title sequence post-production for the Apple TV+ limited series.

media.caption: Digital Kitchen shaped an unsettling title sequence for Before around grief, loss, and ties to the past.
The visual approach blends archival and modern looks into a dreamscape where time feels directionless.
Infrared digital cameras and vintage lenses helped create the sequence's otherworldly atmosphere.

items.title: Pocket Garden
items.description: Open source Google Maps Geospatial API demo showcasing GPS-based VPS technology, produced for its debut at Google I/O.

media.caption: Pocket Garden showcased Google's Geospatial API through an open source AR demo for developers.
The experience turned real-world location data into a playful spatial garden for Google I/O.
BUCK's demo used ARCore and location-aware interaction to explore how digital objects can inhabit public space.
The project paired developer utility with a friendly visual system designed to make VPS technology legible.

items.title: Faith and Liberty Discovery Center
items.description: Philadelphia museum featuring interactive exhibitry, tangible media, and immersive experiences. $2.75M content development and design phase.

media.caption: Local Projects designed the museum as an immersive exploration of values behind American democracy.
The visit centers on Liberty, Justice, and Hope through media-rich galleries instead of a traditional timeline.
Visitors use a digital torch called The Lamp to collect resonant quotes, songs, and stories.
The Unity gallery weaves individual choices into a collective data portrait.

items.title: New York City Ballet Art Series
items.client: New York City Ballet / Lincoln Center
items.description: Immersive multimedia installation in the Promenade of Lincoln Center's David H. Koch Theater by artist Santtu Mustonen.

media.caption: Santtu Mustonen combined handcrafted imagery with new technology for New York City Ballet's 2017 Art Series.

items.title: Spotify Year in Music 2016
items.description: WebGL and API integration for the inaugural Spotify Wrapped campaign - the first edition of what became one of the most celebrated annual digital experiences.

media.caption: Stink Studios partnered with Spotify to turn listener data into personalized Year in Music insights.
The WebGL centerpiece used Spotify's API, custom shaders, gradients, and duotone effects to visualize the year.
A custom CMS supported copy updates and translations across 35 languages and 57 countries.

items.title: Robert Rauschenberg Foundation
items.description: Foundation portal and dynamic archive built in Drupal, creating a living digital home for the legacy of one of America's most influential artists.

media.caption: The Robert Rauschenberg Foundation site brings together the artist's work, archives, programs, and legacy.

items.title: DreamboxXx Video Arcade Residency
items.description: Custom arcade cabinet development at Dreamhouse Queens - a creative queer safe space merged with a DIY tech collective, culminating in 9 original games known as the Dreamboxxx.

media.caption: DreamboxXx joined Death By Audio Arcade and The Dreamhouse around DIY games and queer culture.
The custom cabinet features nine games by queer designers built around an unusual shared-button control scheme.
The residency paired Dreamhouse's community space with DBAA's collaborative arcade-building practice.
